name: harness.plugin.harness_spawner
description: First-class child harness spawning service with child ServiceContext isolation, k=1 probe trial gates, dual token/rollout budgets, DAG lifecycle tracking, and reviewed knowledge merge-back
author: Brain Harness Authors

entrypoints.name: spawn_child_harness
entrypoints.description: Spawn an isolated child harness validated by SurfaceSpec and a k=1 deterministic probe gate

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Short lowercase identifier for the child harness

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain scope for the child ExperienceLibrary partition

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Task description assigned to the spawned child harness

parameters.name: max_tokens
parameters.description: Token ceiling for dual budget enforcement (default 16000)

parameters.name: save_dir
parameters.description: Root directory for isolated child partitions
